b01d43c98405358e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أسواق الزهراء التجارية عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة استلام وتخزين وصرف المواد والسلع، بالإضافة إلى المشاركة في عمليات الجرد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الأخرى داخل المستودع، ووضعها في الأماكن المخصصة لها، وتثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها. تحضير المواد وتجهيزها وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف، وذلك وفقاً لآلية الصرف المعتمدة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب، وحفظ جميع المعاملات المتعلقة بإدخالات وإخراجات المستودع. المشاركة الفعالة في جرد المخزون ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع أرصدة الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المستودعات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على استلام وتصنيف وتخزين المواد بكفاءة. مهارات جيدة في تنظيم العمل والالتزام بالإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، ضمن بيئة عمل منظمة تركز على كفاءة إدارة المخزون. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

b0059c9e52d54591.description: About Rize Rize is a rent-now-pay-later platform operating in Saudi Arabia, focused on making renting more accessible and affordable. The company aims to support tenants in managing finances and landlords in securing income within the rental market. Rize is committed to innovation and driving change in the real estate sector, operating with a diverse team from its office in Riyadh. Role Overview Rize is seeking a Head of Operations with over 10 years of experience for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role involves building and leading a unified Operations department responsible for all post-sale activities, including checking, contracting, landlord payments, collections, customer service, and renewals. The primary objective is to scale Rize's operational capacity significantly, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and automation to support increased volume. Key Responsibilities Integrate Credit Operations, Contracting and Fulfilment, Collections and Payments, and Customer Experience and Renewals into a single operational structure, defining clear roles, service levels, and handovers to Risk, Sales, and Finance. Reduce the time from approval to signed contract, Ejar registration, and landlord payout, while managing shifts and payout runs to enable same-day payments. Serve as the business owner for operations automation, collaborating with Product and Tech teams to determine system functionalities versus manual processes, aiming to increase output per employee. Ensure end-to-end tracking of every case with recorded justifications, maintaining a single, accurate data source for Operations, Risk, and Finance, suitable for lender and external audits. Implement the collections strategy defined by the Risk department, managing on-time collections, cure rates, recovery efforts, and cost to collect. Enhance customer experience and renewal processes for tenants, landlords, and brokers. Develop and maintain the operations manual, service levels, and internal controls. Forecast capacity requirements in anticipation of volume growth and prepare operations for expansion into new cities and product offerings. Develop team leads into managers, establishing clear job levels and career progression paths. Provide regular reports to the leadership team on operational speed, quality, cost, and customer outcomes. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of experience in operations management. Demonstrated ability to build and scale operational departments. Experience in process optimization and automation. Strong analytical skills for tracking performance metrics and ensuring data accuracy. Leadership capabilities to develop and manage teams effectively. Company Values Rize operates on core values including Innovation, focusing on technology to advance the real estate sector; Customer Centricity, placing customer needs at the forefront; Adaptability, responding quickly to market changes; Empowerment & Collaboration, valuing team contributions and autonomy; and Ethical Excellence, maintaining high ethical standards in all operations. Work Environment The team at Rize is diverse and collaborative, working from an office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The environment encourages creativity and innovative problem-solving. This is a full-time position.

b010a79d1eb6d46b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة فرزه التجارية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. يركز أخصائي المبيعات على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ التقارير والوثائق في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الاتجاهات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع العملاء والزملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات في مؤسسة فرزه التجارية ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة عمل ديناميكية في بريدة، القصيم. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتحقيق الأهداف البيعية المحددة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم على هذا الدور في مؤسسة فرزه التجارية.

b003bfc4dbe6290f.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Physicist & Radiation Safety Officer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assessing and ensuring the quality and continuity of the radiation protection program within Fakeeh Health Care facilities. The officer will also be responsible for sharing program information with staff and ensuring their compliance with established parameters. Establish and implement radiation safety policies and procedures in accordance with care standards and local authorities. Develop and maintain a generic radiation protection program aligned with national and international standards. Conduct regular assessments and updates of the radiation safety program. b0eb4dd586057ac0.description: About Mozn MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence. We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact. If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises. About the role You will be the operational owner for production health of our financial crime intelligence platform: data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and the FCI backend services (APIs, graph/network services and databases). You monitor, triage, diagnose and fix incidents, keep scheduled pipelines running, and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes, runbooks and monitoring. You work directly with fraud investigators, analysts and the customer's IT/operations teams. What you'll do Monitor daily data pipeline runs (Python/Polars/Pandas scripts, Airflow DAGs, scheduled jobs); detect failures, delays and data-quality problems before users do. Triage and resolve production incidents: read logs, reproduce with sample data, find root cause (schema/dtype drift, corrupt or empty files, upstream delays, memory pressure, SQL errors) and apply or propose a tested fix. Support platform backend (FastAPI services, graph/network API, PostgreSQL, Oracle sources): investigate slow or failing API calls, 5xx errors, memory growth and pod restarts using application logs, request traces and container metrics. Run, re-run and back-fill pipelines safely (full vs incremental loads, dry-run modes, catch-up of missed days) and verify the output. Execute and validate database changes and migrations in UAT and production following the change process, with rollback steps. Operate in containerized environments (OpenShift/Kubernetes, Docker): check pod health, resource limits, environment settings, rollouts and logs using CLI tools, within namespace-level access. Own incident communication: clear status updates, impact assessment and post-incident summaries for business and technical audiences. Write and maintain runbooks, known-error lists and operational checklists; automate repetitive checks and alerts. Reduce alert noise and tune alerting; make sure manual re-runs do not trigger duplicate customer-facing alerts. Work with data engineers and developers to hand over defects with reproducible evidence, and to validate fixes through UAT before release. Support onboarding of new data sources and data requests where operations are involved. Follow security and data-handling rules: least-privilege access, no sensitive data in tickets or logs, approved change windows. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data engineering, production support, or a similar operations-focused technical role Strong Python skills for ETL development and debugging (Pandas and/or Polars; reading stack traces and fixing data type, schema and null-handling issues) Strong SQL skills (PostgreSQL and/or Oracle): complex queries, query plans, partitioned tables, running and validating migrations Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, including scheduling, incremental vs full loads, back-fills and failure recovery Solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star schema, fact and dimension tables) and file formats such as Parquet Experience consuming and troubleshooting RESTful APIs (status codes, latency, authentication, timeouts) Working knowledge of Linux command line, log analysis (grep, jq, tail) and shell scripting Working experience with Docker and containers; basic Kubernetes/OpenShift operations (oc/kubectl: logs, describe, rollout, resource limits) Structured incident handling: prioritisation, root-cause analysis, documentation Strong client-facing and written/verbal communication skills; comfortable explaining technical issues to non-technical users Nice to have Experience with Apache Airflow or other workflow orchestration Knowledge of backend system and basic API development; understanding of OpenTelemetry-style tracing and structured JSON logs Experience with diagnosing memory or performance issues in Python services Experience with Git and a code review/release workflow; ability to submit small, tested fixes Exposure to graph analysis, fraud, AML or banking data and the investigation workflow Familiarity with monitoring and dashboard tools (Grafana, Prometheus) Exposure to PySpark, message queues or streaming platforms (Kafka, IBMQ) Understanding of data quality frameworks and governance practices Experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow, Jira) and SLAs Willingness to join an on-call rota for critical production incidents Benefits You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space. You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best. The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI. We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves.

b0007b0a1f3fe60e.description: The Senior Systems Engineer – Enterprise Services is responsible for the administration, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure and Microsoft-based technology solutions across ZainTECH's customer environments. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, implementation records, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Document infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure accurate technical records. Provide regular technical status updates and progress reports to Project Managers, supervisors, and relevant stakeholders. Communicate incidents, technical risks, and operational issues clearly, escalating matters requiring management attention. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance infrastructure performance, security, and service delivery quality. Our Culture & Code of Conduct: At ZainTECH, we take pride in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and uncompromising integrity. All employees are expected to uphold our Code of Conduct, which serves as a guiding framework for responsible behavior across everything we do — from ho we work with each other to how we engage with clients and partners globally. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and related collaboration platforms. b024d57ac24cbf21.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عدوان للتسويق عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم للمهندسين الكهربائيين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية المتعلقة بالأنظمة الكهربائية. الإشراف على توريد المنتجات الكهربائية للعملاء والتأكد من توفير الاحتياجات اللازمة وفقًا للمواصفات المتفق عليها لتلبية متطلبات المشاريع. تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار الأنظمة الكهربائية بعد تركيبها لضمان التزامها بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة. القيام بعمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن أعمال الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ التركيب والصيانة للأنظمة الكهربائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

b0a1fc48745b1165.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب عبدالعزيز محمد ابراهيم الوصابي لهندسة المشاريع عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة للمشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك المسح الاستطلاعي والتسوية ورسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة لمختلف المشاريع الإنشائية. إعداد مسودات تفصيلية للمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط. اختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة لكل مهمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على أرض الواقع. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات. تثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها. توقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المساحة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية. مهارة في استخدام الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية. القدرة على قراءة ورسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني المساحة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق المكتب في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني لتنفيذ المهام المساحية في مواقع المشاريع المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

b0e9f09654438cff.description: About Remedica Remedica is an EU-based pharmaceutical company, established in 1980 and headquartered in Cyprus. The company operates globally, with a presence in over 110 countries. Remedica functions as a trusted generics CDMO and dossier development partner, offering a portfolio of over 300 products across various therapeutic areas, including cardiovascular, oncology, anti-diabetic, anti-infective, central nervous system, alimentary tract, genito-urinary, and musculoskeletal treatments. The company has undergone a significant transformation to become a global player, recognized for its development expertise, EU-based manufacturing capabilities, regulatory knowledge, and strong quality culture. The Role: Key Account Manager GCC Remedica is seeking a Key Account Manager GCC to join its MEA team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on managing and developing Remedica’s business with assigned distributors and key accounts across the GCC region. The Key Account Manager is responsible for achieving agreed sales, profitability, and collection targets, developing account plans, strengthening customer relationships, coordinating tender participation, and supporting portfolio growth through collaboration with internal functions and local partners. This position is open to Saudi nationals. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary commercial contact for assigned GCC distributors and key accounts, building sustainable relationships and conducting regular business reviews. Develop and implement annual account plans covering sales, profitability, collections, tenders, and portfolio development. Monitor distributor sales, stock levels, and market coverage to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. Deliver agreed sales, gross profit, and collection targets for assigned accounts and markets. Identify opportunities for portfolio expansion, new product introductions, and business development with public and private sector accounts. Support negotiations on pricing, payment terms, and other commercial conditions within approved authority limits. Identify and track tender opportunities, coordinating tender assessment, preparation, and timely submission. Prepare and maintain sales forecasts, demand plans, monthly shipment plans, and collection projections. Monitor orders through the ERP system and coordinate with Order Execution and Supply Chain for timely delivery. Monitor receivables, overdue balances, and payment commitments in coordination with Finance. Prepare accurate performance reports, account reviews, forecasts, and market updates. Maintain complete customer records, commercial agreements, and account documentation. Qualifications and Experience Experience required: 5-10 years in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to manage key accounts and distributor relationships. Proven track record of achieving sales, profitability, and collection targets. Strong understanding of market trends, competitor activity, and customer requirements in the GCC region. Ability to coordinate tender processes and institutional business. Proficiency in financial management and reporting related to sales and collections. Compensation and Benefits Remedica offers a competitive compensation package, including 14 salaries, a provident fund, and additional benefits. The salary for this position is not disclosed. Equal Opportunity Statement Remedica is committed to equal pay for equal work and work of equal value. Roles are evaluated using a structured, gender-neutral job evaluation framework that assesses knowledge, skills, responsibilities, effort, and working conditions. Applications from all qualified candidates are welcomed, regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, sexual orientation, gender identity, or age.

b09a1314c9b20e9c.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a BIM Engineer to join the site-based Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the implementation, coordination, and management of Building Information Modeling (BIM) processes throughout the construction phase of a major landmark development project. The successful candidate will ensure alignment with project requirements, digital delivery standards, and client objectives. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and execution of BIM requirements across construction activities. Review and validate BIM models for compliance with project standards, BIM Execution Plans (BEP), and employer requirements. Coordinate multidisciplinary models and assist in identifying, tracking, and resolving clashes and design conflicts. Review contractor BIM deliverables, including models, shop drawings, and digital submissions. Monitor model quality, data integrity, and compliance with project BIM protocols. Perform model audits and support the management of a Common Data Environment (CDE). Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of BIM outputs. Support construction planning, sequencing, quantity verification, and visualization using BIM tools. Generate BIM reports, model reviews, coordination records, and project dashboards. Assist with as-built model development, testing, commissioning, and digital handover requirements. Ensure BIM-related deliverables support project quality, scheduling, and asset information requirements. Support the Resident Engineer and Construction Manager in achieving project objectives through effective digital delivery. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 10+ years of BIM experience on major building, infrastructure, or mixed-use development projects. Proficiency in Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and BIM 360/Autodesk Construction Cloud. Experience in BIM coordination, clash detection, model review, and multidisciplinary integration. Strong understanding of ISO 19650 standards and BIM execution processes. Experience reviewing contractor BIM submissions and digital deliverables. Strong communication, stakeholder coordination, and reporting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Desired Skills Previous experience within a Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC), PMC, or engineering consultancy environment. Experience on mega projects, hospitality developments, airports, convention centers, or large mixed-use developments. Knowledge of 4D construction sequencing and 5D quantity/cost integration. Experience managing Common Data Environments (CDE) and digital document control systems. Familiarity with asset information models, digital handover, and facilities management integration. Professional BIM certifications from Autodesk, BRE Academy, or equivalent institutions. Strong organizational skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced project environment. Work Environment This position is a full-time role based on-site in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of a Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) team for a major landmark development project.

b0de3d073dd5804b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مكه الفندقية، فندق ابراج، عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، تقدير المواد، متابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال لضمان سلامة وكفاءة الأنظمة الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات (المنزلية، الصناعية، التجارية) ومكوناتها. تقدير الكميات المطلوبة من المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، والإشراف على تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية. الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التمديدات الكهربائية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الصيانة في فندق ابراج التابع لشركة مكه الفندقية في مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

b02cc1c87e70a267.description: About Masan Properties Masan Properties is a design-driven property developer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. b06328db424471f9.description: عامل خدمات مساندة مهنته الأساسية تحميل وتنزيل بالاضافة إلى متابعة اعمال التحميل والتنزيل لدى المستأجرين والتأكد من كونهم ملتزمين بالاشتراطات وتوجييههم باتباع السياسات والاجراءات المتبعة والبلاغ عن المخالفات الحاصلة.

b0ab632196cf877a.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking a Manager People Analytics to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is situated within the Workplace Engineering function, which operates at the intersection of HR analytics and Product Engineering. The position reports directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, within the Data discipline of the People department. Role Context and Purpose The Workplace Engineering function transforms workforce data into "People Products" designed to enhance performance. This role moves beyond traditional reporting to engineer tools and insights that influence future outcomes. Experienced data professionals at Canonical integrate software, data, and business objectives to transform analytical artifacts into strategic assets, elevating decision-making and innovation across global operations, including sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources. They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, developing experiments, automations, and products that convert insights into tangible outcomes. The role also contributes to shaping the future of the AI/Data stack in open source. Key Responsibilities Lead and mentor a specialized squad comprising People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers, functioning as a product squad leader. Serve as Product Owner for People Science initiatives, translating human behavioral intent for engineering teams. Develop strategic insights and drive business outcomes by moving beyond descriptive metrics to predictive and prescriptive analytics, such as forecasting attrition risk based on engagement data. Act as a "Translator-in-Chief," converting complex data models into clear narratives and leading the development of AI Agents for real-time insight delivery to managers. Ensure the People Data Stack is secure, compliant with GDPR and privacy regulations, and serves as a single source of truth for all People-related offerings. Identify opportunities to integrate high-tech solutions into People offerings to optimize human involvement and maximize value. Required Qualifications and Skills A background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, with proficiency in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL), or software engineering. Strong skills in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript), software engineering, data visualization (*, Superset, Tableau), and automation. Ability to translate business questions into key research objectives and identify appropriate methodologies for execution, synthesis, and analysis of findings. Proven ability to lead and guide teams to execute against planned roadmaps, demonstrating a strong mentor/coaching mindset. Willingness to challenge the status quo and maintain resilience in the face of challenges. Ambition to contribute to the development of tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source. An exceptional academic record from high school and university. Business-level written and spoken English. Sincere personal motivation aligned with Canonical's mission. Availability for international travel 2-4 times a year for company events, each up to two weeks long. Experience required: 5-10 years. About Canonical Canonical is a technology firm recognized for its contributions to open source. Its platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company serves leading public cloud and silicon providers, as well as industry leaders across various sectors. Canonical is founder-led, profitable, and expanding. Operating with a globally distributed collaboration model since 2004, Canonical maintains no central headquarters, with most colleagues working remotely. The company emphasizes high expectations and a commitment to excellence, fostering an environment that encourages continuous learning and development. Equal Opportunity Employer Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination. The company values diversity of experience, perspectives, and background, recognizing their contribution to a better work environment and improved products. All applications receive fair consideration regardless of identity.

b074cad9bebf03fb.description: About Alnafitha IT Alnafitha IT, established in 1993, is a leading independent provider of IT services and solutions in Saudi Arabia. b05a37b17cc400ad.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جست كلين للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم نجاح الشركاء التشغيليين وضمان تقديم أفضل تجربة لهم، بالإضافة إلى المساهمة في تنمية الأعمال من خلال إدارة علاقات العملاء وتعزيز فرص المبيعات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعتبر وظيفة بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وإدارة قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، وتحديث بيانات الاتصال والعناوين بشكل دوري. التواصل مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو وسائل الاتصال المختلفة للترويج للخدمات والمنتجات. تقديم العروض التجارية وشرح مزايا الخدمات والميزات التنافسية بما يساهم في تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. التفاوض على الأسعار وتقديم الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المعتمدة لإتمام عمليات البيع. متابعة دورة البيع كاملة بدءًا من استقطاب العميل وحتى إتمام التعاقد أو البيع وتوثيق العمليات ذات العلاقة. تحصيل مستحقات العملاء ومتابعة الديون المستحقة والتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية لضمان السداد في الوقت المحدد. إعداد تقارير دورية عن نشاط المبيعات، الفرص التجارية، وحالة العملاء ومشاركتها مع الإدارة. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء والشركاء بما يدعم النمو واستمرارية الأعمال. دعم العمليات التشغيلية يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية متابعة الأداء اليومي وحل المشكلات التشغيلية التي قد تواجه الشركاء. يشمل ذلك التنسيق الفعال مع الفرق الداخلية المختلفة لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة عالية وتحقيق أهداف الخدمة المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتنمية الأعمال. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في جست كلين للتجارة.

b007e816d00f8b77.description: About the Role FAENA is seeking a Hygiene Manager to oversee food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards across FAENA The Red Sea in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing hygiene procedures, HACCP requirements, and inspections, ensuring the property is prepared for opening and maintains high standards during daily operations. Key Responsibilities Oversee hygiene, sanitation, and food safety standards across the property in line with applicable regulations and FAENA requirements. Manage the implementation and ongoing review of HACCP procedures and food safety management systems. Plan and conduct hygiene inspections, audits, and risk assessments in food preparation, storage, and service areas. Work closely with Culinary, Stewarding, Food & Beverage, and Engineering to address hygiene concerns and maintain operational readiness. Prepare and deliver food safety and hygiene briefings and training in coordination with relevant departments. Maintain accurate hygiene records, inspection reports, audit findings, and supporting documentation. Coordinate preparations for relevant authority inspections and external food safety audits. Provide management with updates on hygiene performance, key risks, and required improvements. Support pre-opening preparations and ensure hygiene procedures are in place ahead of hotel operations. Promote safe working practices and encourage consistent hygiene standards across the teams. b07b8e1a7386876d.description: About IBM Consulting IBM Consulting focuses on building long-term client relationships and fostering global collaboration. Professionals within IBM Consulting work with leading companies across various industries, assisting them in their hybrid cloud and AI initiatives. The environment supports continuous learning and innovation, encouraging individuals to challenge existing norms and develop effective solutions. Role Overview IBM is seeking a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA SCM PP to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. b09db7285d5ff70c.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Refund Lead Auditor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is for an experienced professional capable of conducting work with general directions, focusing on developing solutions to challenges requiring analysis and addressing escalated issues. The position involves complex operational activities, including researching industries for revenue benchmarking and developing audit reports within established policies and procedures. Refund Planning Responsibilities Review and study refund policies to stay current on refund limit utilization, risk control authorizations, and applicable margins, ensuring adherence to ZATCA’s rules, regulations, policies, and procedures. Develop and update assessment templates and audit tools in accordance with operational procedures and policies to facilitate customer request analysis and timely evaluation. Keep abreast of the latest developments, news, and updates by industry type and sector (*, business and insurance, telecommunication, consumer goods) to incorporate new tax practices adopted by taxpayers and businesses into assessments and audit reviews. Maintain and update refund manuals, eligibility criteria, legal requirements, and supporting documents by taxpayer type, integrating them into computer-aided audit tools to facilitate audit assessment and review. Refund Operations and Case Management Consolidate, categorize, and prioritize refund requests and schedules, sorting them by tax/industry type and ensuring dispatch to relevant audit teams for assessment and review. Review refund applications and requests, examine the validity of legal documents presented by taxpayers, and ensure completeness of supporting documents prior to case assessment and evaluation. Gather necessary data for desk audits, communicate with relevant stakeholders (account managers, taxpayers, banks, audit bureau, government entities) to obtain information and clarifications, and consult with the legal function for contractual structures to safeguard applicant legitimacy. Research public news, articles, databases, and shared channels to investigate and understand taxpayers’ business activity, including structure, size, process, and jurisdictions. Study and assess taxpayers’ financial status, income statements, financial strength and capabilities, and revenue streams to compare with benchmarks and similar industries, deciding on the appropriate assessment approach (actual, estimated, reduced assessments). Inspect and investigate taxpayers’ declarations, pinpoint high-risk and speculative issues, detect non-compliant cases, and communicate with internal stakeholders to avoid potential risks, including tax evasion. Consolidate legal and financial observations, study, and evaluate them against pre-approved eligibility criteria and refund requirements to recommend approval/rejection decisions in line with applicable policies and procedures. Manage the development of audit reports, including tax assessments (actual/reduced/estimated assessments), to identify taxpayers’ refund amounts. Develop lists of compliant taxpayers with accepted refunds and related amounts, submitting them to internal committees to secure necessary approvals for payment release/transfer. Monitor taxpayer objections and appeals, ensuring coordination with Legal Affairs or AMANA to resolve disputes and support key testimonies by providing clarifications on final audit findings and results. Maintain and update refund operations-related systems and databases, ensuring all audit findings are administered and stored securely to facilitate data exchange with internal stakeholders and other government agencies. Reporting and Support Draft refund audit reports to highlight recommendations and conclusions along with relevant evidence, proofs, and supporting documents, escalating them for revision and verification. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. This role requires professionals capable of conducting work with general directions and developing solutions to complex challenges. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

b08d8fedd88e3697.description: About the Role AWN ENTERPRISES is seeking a Food Cost Controller to join our team in Al Khobar. Key Responsibilities Monitor actual food and beverage costs against budgeted and theoretical costs for business units. Analyze food cost percentages, consumption trends, price fluctuations, and cost variances, identifying deviations and recommending corrective actions. Prepare and maintain standardized recipe costing sheets, including ingredient quantities, unit costs, portion sizes, and yield calculations. A key aspect is highlighting unusual price increases and deviations from procurement procedures. Reporting and Compliance This position is responsible for robust reporting and ensuring compliance with financial controls. This includes reconciling purchases, inventory movements, and consumption for accurate food cost reporting. The Food Cost Controller will maintain proper documentation for all inventory and cost-related activities, support internal and external audits, and coordinate with the Finance department to ensure accurate posting and classification of food and beverage costs in ERP systems like SAP. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in food cost control, inventory control, or cost accounting. Experience preferably within restaurants, hotels, catering, or multi-outlet F&B operations. Practical experience in recipe costing, stocktaking, inventory reconciliation, and food cost analysis. Experience working with SAP or other ERP systems is preferred. b0b9b7053efb2f6b.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable. This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure. We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects. Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision. What You Will Do ❓ Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. What Are We Looking For❓ Essential Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, prioritizing algorithmic depth over superficial multi-language breadth. Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns. Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience. Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software. Comprehensive mental model of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management. Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives. Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors. Expectations by Seniority Level Core requirements apply universally, with ownership and operational scale adjusting based on candidate seniority. Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Prior agentic experience is not required; mentorship is provided to expand scope over well-defined modules. Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production services. Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations. Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling. Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling. Active open-source contributions or community engagement. Out of Scope Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem. Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation. Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows. Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning. Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally. Technical Standards & Architecture Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-office, and hybrid work setups. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
